paragraphs.text: Lita , Mechanical Engineer is a legendary artifact creature artificer from Avishkar .

As a mechanical being, her strength far surpasses those of normal humanoids, and she can be seen carrying large and heavy metallic machine parts in her work. Lita can build Zeppelins, which are flying vehicles . Her body is made of copper plate and filigree, shaped to resemble armor, and she has a delicate yet strong face with glowing green eyes.
